event: NASA Artemis II Lunar Flyby Mission
claim: Artemis II crew completes lunar flyby and returns safely to Earth by April 11 2026 UTC

claim_holder.claim: Artemis II crew completes lunar flyby and returns safely to Earth by April 11 2026 UTC

challenger.claim: Mission anomaly or timeline slip prevents nominal return

evidence.location: Pacific Ocean, off coast of San Diego
evidence.commander_report: What a journey. We are stable. Four green crew members.

resolution.reasoning_trace: Artemis II splashed down at 00:07 UTC April 11, within the April 11 UTC deadline. All four crew members reported green status. Nominal lunar flyby completed with closest approach 4,070 miles from lunar surface. Challenger thesis of anomaly or timeline slip was invalidated — mission completed on schedule.
